goal: Produce a local-only Markdown report (saved to disk) that cross-tabulates offline_data/students.csv by grade (G10/G11/G12) × region (A/B/C/D), reports row count and reading_score mean per cell, identifies the highest- and lowest-mean combinations with sample sizes, and annotates every key number with its source; return the absolute path of the report file.

plan.title: Load & aggregate students.csv: Read offline_data/students.csv; group by (grade ∈ {G10,G11,G12}) × (region ∈ {A,B,C,D}); for each of the 12 cells compute row_count and mean(reading_score); also identify the cell with the highest mean and the cell with the lowest mean (tie-break by larger sample size, then lexicographic). Save the 12-row cross-tab to offline_data/students_grade_region_summary.csv with columns grade, region, row_count, reading_score_mean, plus a flag column is_max_mean / is_min_mean.

Write Markdown report: Using the saved summary CSV, write a Markdown report to offline_data/students_grade_region_report.md containing: (1) a level-1 title; (2) a 3×4 data table of row_count and reading_score_mean per cell; (3) a short section naming the max-mean and min-mean combinations with their sample sizes; (4) every key number annotated inline as 「（来源：offline_data/students.csv 的 reading_score，按 grade×region 分组，样本行数=N）」 and any derived ratio as 「（来源：由前述两行计算）」; (5) a concluding paragraph at the end. No web data.
